::: {#def-lora}

#### Low-rank adaptation (LoRA)

**Low-rank adaptation**,
or **LoRA**,
adapts a [pretrained](attention-transformers.qmd#def-pretraining) layer with weight matrix $\matr{W}_0$ by keeping $\matr{W}_0$ fixed
and learning an $m \times r$ matrix $\matr{B}$ and an $r \times n$ matrix $\matr{A}$,
where $\matr{W}_0$ is $m \times n$ and the [rank](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-subspaces.html#def-rank) $r$ is much smaller than $m$ and $n$.
The adapted layer maps $\vx$ to $\matr{W}_0 \vx + \matr{B}\matr{A}\vx$
[@hu2022lora, section 4.1].
$\matr{B}$ starts at zero,
so the adapted network starts as the pretrained one.
@hu2022lora also scale $\matr{B}\matr{A}\vx$ by a constant.

:::
